rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for someone who writes scripts for films or television.

example.english: I want to be a screenwriter who specializes in writing television scripts.
example.traditional: 我想做編劇，專門寫電視劇本。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 pin1 kek6 zyun1 mun4 se2 din6 si6 kek6 bun2
